text: City Council on September 30, October 1 and 2, 2020, referred Administrative Inquiry IA24.2 from Councillor James Pasternak, Ward 6, York Centre regarding Drone Safety in the City of Toronto and Answer 24.2a from the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards to the Executive Committee for consideration.

The Executive Committee: 1. Requested the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards to continue to monitor the federal regulatory framework for drone use in Toronto airspace and report back to the Executive Committee on any changes to the federal rules that might impact municipalities and/or if there is a surge of incidents and resident complaints of drone use in Toronto.
